summary: Implemented both VPKG commands, translated menus, and regression tests; the full VM gate and Python oracle passed.
body:
Changed 18 files:

- Engine: `Cargo.toml`, `src/{commands.rs,interchange.rs,lib.rs}` and new [vpkg.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/vpkgengine/crates/engine/src/vpkg.rs), [vpkg_tests.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/vpkgengine/crates/engine/src/vpkg_tests.rs).
- UI: `src/{lib.rs,menus.rs}` and `src/i18n/{es,zh-cn,ja,pt-br,fr,de,it,ko,id}.tsv`.
- [docs/control-protocol.md](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/vpkgengine/docs/control-protocol.md).

Public command API:

```text
file.importVpkg {
  path: str,
  dir?: str,
  mode?: "rendered" | "native" | "hybrid", // default hybrid
  lenient?: bool                         // default false
}
file.exportVpkg {
  path: str,
  sequence?: id,
  id?: str,
  version?: str,                         // default "1.0.0"
  title?: str
}
```

Import returns the existing scene-import result plus `package: {id, version, title, primaryScene, extractedTo, warnings}`. Export returns `{path, bytes, report}`. Package verification errors use `EngineError::InvalidPackage`, serialized as `{error, diagnostics:[{severity,rule,path,line,message}]}`, matching scene errors.

Rust entry points:

```rust
pub fn import(s: &mut Session, p: &Value) -> Result<Value>;
pub fn export(s: &mut Session, p: &Value) -> Result<Value>;
```

Added default `Services` hooks, with bounded reads and exclusive creation implemented by `FsServices`:

```rust
fn read_file_bounded(&self, path: &str, max_bytes: usize) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>>;
fn package_dir_empty(&self, dir: &str) -> io::Result<bool>;
fn package_path(&self, dir: &str, relative: &str) -> io::Result<String>;
fn create_parent_dirs(&self, path: &str) -> io::Result<()>;
fn write_package_file(&self, dir: &str, relative: &str, bytes: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()>;
```

Design decisions and provenance:

- Verification and destination preflight finish before extraction starts. Project changes occur only through the existing scene importer after extraction succeeds, preserving modes, leniency, diagnostics, and one undo step.
- “Package stem” means `demo.vpkg.zip` → `demo/`. An explicit directory permits identical files; different content is refused.
- Native extraction canonicalizes the root and rejects descendant symlinks. This is deliberately stricter than the resolved-containment policy consulted in `sr_core/vpkg/archive.py::inside`. Windows device aliases are also rejected, following [Microsoft’s filename rules](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/desktop/fileio/naming-a-file).
- Fetch declarations and pipelines are never executed. The primary scene must be present in the verified archive.
- Export reuses the existing scene exporter, preserving its XSD-based semantics and loss reports. Sources are sorted and deduplicated, then rewritten to deterministic `assets/<ordinal>-<name>` paths. Missing media names the source in the error. Non-ASCII-only sequence names use the fallback slug `sequence`.
- Packing uses the existing crate’s format 1.1 writer and `source_date_epoch: None`. No new scene-schema interpretations were introduced.
- No code was borrowed. Consulted `sr_core/vpkg/{pack,archive,init}.py`; `ATTRIBUTION.md` therefore remains unchanged. No assets or external dependencies were added.

TDD red → green log (engine test names below have the `vpkg_` prefix):

- `import_fixtures_and_one_undo`: missing `package.id` → passes for all three fixtures and undo.
- `tampered_hash_writes_nothing`, `archive_traversal_writes_nothing`: `unwrap_err()` received `Ok({})` from stubs → diagnostic errors, no writes, unchanged project.
- `collision_and_write_failure_preserve_project`, `filesystem_symlink_escape`: expected error assertions failed → collisions, disk failure, and escaping links rejected.
- `round_trip_media_and_clip_count`, `filesystem_import`: imported sequence was absent → expected two clips and exact media bytes preserved.
- `missing_media_is_error`: error lacked `pixel.png` → missing filename reported without archive output.
- `hostile_params_and_size`: stub accepted `null` → malformed parameters and oversized input rejected before reading.
- `explicit_directory_allows_identical_reimport`: `extractedTo` was null → identical reuse works across all three modes.
- `export_defaults_and_duplicate_names`: output archive was absent → defaults and unique media names verified.
- `native_lenient_matches_scene`: expected error received `Ok({})` → strict refusal and lenient dropping match scene import.
- UI `vpkg_import_menu_opens_dialog`: `{}` instead of `{"dialog":"open"}`; `vpkg_export_menu_has_save_filter`: missing filter → both pass.
- `extraction_rejects_device_aliases`: failed with `accepted device alias CON` → passes after the guard.

The completed stub baseline had 12 engine failures; the later device-alias round had 13 passes and one failure. Final focused run: all 14 engine tests and both UI tests passed.

Final VM validation exited **0**:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo fmt --check` | Passed |
| Workspace clippy, all targets, `-D warnings` | Passed |
| Engine tests | 688 passed, 3 ignored |
| UI unit and integration tests | 643 passed, 4 ignored |
| VPKG tests including doctest | 35 passed, 2 ignored |
| Additional interchange suite | 320 passed, 7 ignored |
| `cargo xtask layers` | Passed |
| `cargo xtask wasm` | Passed, 51 crates |

Total: **1,686 passed, zero failed**, with 16 existing ignored tests. The explicit oracle run with `SR_CORE_DIR=$HOME/sr-core` passed: `python3 -m sr_core.vpkg verify …/export.vpkg.zip` printed `ok`. Without its prerequisites, the oracle prints `skipped`.

All builds ran through the VM wrapper. After an initial memory-related SIGKILL, validation used two build jobs, two test threads, and dev/test debug information and default optimization disabled. Full results: [validation log](/tmp/vpkgengine-validation.log).

Integrator notes: refresh Cargo.lock to add `filmcraft-vpkg` to the engine dependency list; that file was outside my edit scope, and Cargo refreshed it in the validated VM checkout. Extraction can leave files behind after a later write failure, but leaves the project unchanged. Native path checks do not provide a sandbox against concurrent directory replacement; custom hosts with aliases or concurrent writers should override the documented Services hooks. No commits or pushes were made.
